categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 超 魔 神 龍 神 丸 、Ｈ Ｇ に 降 臨 ！
description.en: The super demon Ryujin Maru descends on HG!

description.ja: 『超魔神英雄伝ワタル』より、超魔神龍神丸が完全新規造形のHGシリーズで商品化。
description.en: From ``Choumashin Hero Wataru'', Choumajin Ryujinmaru is commercialized in the HG series with a completely new model.

description.ja: 聖神の力を一つにし超力変身した龍神丸の最終形態の機体形状とカラーリングをパーツ分けで再現。
description.en: The final form and coloring of Ryujinmaru, which combines the power of the holy gods and transforms into superpower, is reproduced by dividing it into parts.

description.ja: 関節には引き出し式機構を搭載しボリューム感のある造形ながら剣の両手持ちが可能。
description.en: The joints are equipped with pull-out mechanisms, making it possible to hold the sword with both hands while creating a voluminous shape.

description.ja: 尻尾部分はリード線を内蔵し節ごとに可動する。付属する剣王の剣の宝玉はジュエルシールを採用。
description.en: The tail part has a built-in lead wire and can be moved at each joint. The included jewel of the Sword King's sword uses Jewel Seal.

description.ja: ●　超魔神龍神丸を完全新規造形で立体化。パーツ分割で色分け再現
description.en: ● Super Majin Ryujinmaru has been made into a three-dimensional model with a completely new model. Color-coded reproduction by dividing parts

description.ja: 超魔神龍神丸の特徴的なフォルムを完全新規造形でＨＧ化。
description.en: The characteristic form of Super Majin Ryujinmaru has been transformed into HG with a completely new model.

description.ja: 肩部やシールド部分など成形色によるパーツ分割で再現。金色部分にはゴールドの成形色、目と腕部の宝玉にはクリアグリーンを採用。
description.en: Reproduced by dividing parts by molding color such as shoulders and seal parts. The gold parts are molded in gold, and the jewels on the eyes and arms are clear green.

description.ja: 頭部
description.en: head

description.ja: 黒いラインは別パーツにて再現。
description.en: The black line is reproduced with separate parts.

description.ja: 肩部
description.en: shoulder area

description.ja: 肩部やシールドのカラーリングをパーツ分けで再現。
description.en: The coloring of the shoulders and seals are reproduced by dividing them into parts.

description.ja: 影色となる黒い部分と、腕部などのその他の黒で２種の成形色を採用。
description.en: Two types of molding colors are used: the black part that becomes the shadow color, and the other black parts such as the arms.

description.ja: 尻尾部分は約250mmのビッグサイズ！
description.en: The tail part is a big size of about 250mm!

description.ja: リード線により節ごと可動することで様々なポージングに対応。
description.en: Each joint can be moved using lead wires to accommodate various poses.

description.ja: ●　付属のディスプレイ台座により、超力変身直後の飛翔ポーズでディスプレイ可能。
description.en: ● With the included display pedestal, it can be displayed in a flying pose immediately after the superpower transformation.

description.ja: ●　各部の可動性能により劇中を再現したポージングが可能
description.en: ● Poses that reproduce the play are possible due to the movability of each part.

description.ja: 首の２重関節や各部の可動等により、劇中の印象的なポージングを再現可能。
description.en: The double joints in the neck and the movement of each part allow you to recreate impressive poses from the movie.

description.ja: 降臨した時のポーズを再現可能！
description.en: You can reproduce the pose when it descends!

description.ja: 首の2重関節により頭部を上に向かせることが出来る。
description.en: The double joint in the neck allows the head to turn upwards.

description.ja: さらに、シールド部分も左右に広げることで印象的な劇中のポージングが可能。
description.en: Furthermore, the seal part can be expanded to the left and right to create impressive poses in the play.

description.ja: 引き出し式ギミックで両手持ちが可能！
description.en: The pull-out gimmick allows you to hold it with both hands!

description.ja: 肩部には引き出し式の可動機構を搭載。胴体側の前後スイング機構も搭載しており「剣王の剣」を両手持ちすることが可能。
description.en: Equipped with a pull-out movable mechanism on the shoulder. It is also equipped with a back and forth swing mechanism on the torso side, allowing it to hold the "Sword of the Sword King" with both hands.

description.ja: ●　「剣王の剣」が付属！
description.en: ● "Sword of the Sword King" is included!

description.ja: 剣中央部と左右の宝玉にジュエルシールを採用。左右武器持ち手、左右平手、左右握り手が付属。
description.en: Jewel Seals are used in the center of the sword and on the left and right jewels. Comes with left and right weapon holders, left and right palms, and left and right grips.

description.ja: 付属武装：剣王の剣
description.en: Attached weapon: Sword of the Sword King
